title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: query_nem_data · Public sink: get_fleet_summary, get_rankings · Destructive: get_fleet_summary, get_battery_revenue, list_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: query_nem_data · Public sink: get_fleet_summary, get_rankings · Destructive: get_fleet_summary, get_battery_revenue, list_events

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "query_nem_data" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
